description: This Java class 'ScriptLinkHelper' provides utility methods for managing external script links in web pages, including caching inline scripts per user session, generating script URLs with CSRF tokens, and managing script links for page footer insertion.

classes.name: ScriptLinkHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing script links and inline scripts in web pages, supporting caching, URL generation, and session cleanup.

methods.name: getScriptLinksForBodyEnd
methods.description: Retrieves the set of script URLs designated for insertion at the end of the HTML body.

methods.name: prepareScriptLinkForBodyEnd
methods.description: Prepares and stores a script link for inclusion at the end of the HTML body, generating a URL with CSRF token and caching the script content.
